component.name: Top30
component.summary: Archive VRT Radio 2 Top 30 hit lists to MP3

description.p: Top30 fetches historical VRT Radio 2 Top 30 charts from hitnoteringen.be, searches for each track on YouTube, downloads and converts them to properly tagged MP3 files, and organizes them in your music library.

ul.li: Scrape hit lists by year range
Download videos and convert to MP3
Automatic tagging (artist, title, year, genre, album)
Modern Qt GUI or CLI mode
